mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 1.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating labor market strength) and low UNRATE (< 5%) creates a 'goldilocks' scenario, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion with labor market tightness
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of 'goldilocks' instances, or interaction-driven Rank IC < 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
